recent_en: Aldrich Resources proposed to acquire 90% of GXY for RM13.5 million, to be funded by a 2-for-1 rights issue with warrants. The company reported a net profit of RM35,000 for 1Q FY2026 ended 30 September 2026, with PBT down RM1.16 million QoQ. Chairman Yahya Razali stepped down in October.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 90% equity in GXY for RM13.5 million, funded by a 2-for-1 rights issue with warrants.
1Q FY2026 (ended 30 September 2026) net profit of RM35,000, with PBT down RM1.16 million QoQ.
risks_en: The proposed 2-for-1 rights issue with warrants may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
1Q FY2026 net profit was only RM35,000, with PBT declining significantly QoQ.
earnings_en: 1Q FY2026 (ended 30 September 2026) net profit was RM35,000, with PBT down RM1.16 million QoQ. For the prior quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM5.383 million, net profit RM1.215 million, net margin 22.6%, revenue up 14.8% QoQ, net profit up 268.2% QoQ, revenue up 31.1% YoY, and net profit up 214.0% YoY.
